payload.reason: The evidence indicates that both radiative forcing (RF) and effective radiative forcing (ERF) are calculated, including adjustments for aerosol-cloud and aerosol-radiation interactions.

claims.text: The model calculates effective radiative forcings that explicitly consider cloud adjustments, indicating both RF and ERF are assessed.
The difference between all-sky and clear-sky RF serves as a proxy for aerosol-cloud interactions, confirming the model's capability to evaluate these effects.
The study includes an explicit representation of aerosol-radiation and aerosol-cloud interactions, confirming their calculation in the model.
